instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched ZBrush graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ZScript files, Python, macros, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only ZBrush native GUI tools, menus, brushes, and built-in export commands. Record Two 3D Layers on a Sphere and Export Three Toggle States The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named OrbBase, is a smooth polymesh sphere of radius 1.0 BU at approximately 2048 quads (32 latitude x 32 longitude grid with triangle caps at the poles). It has a single default polygroup, no UVs, no polypaint, and no subdivision stack. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, record two non-destructive 3D Layers on it (Layer A: belt-band depression along z; Layer B: uniform surface noise), and export three OBJs that correspond to these toggle states of the layer stack: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_off.obj` both Layer A and Layer B are OFF `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj` Layer A ON, Layer B OFF `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_on.obj` Layer A and Layer B both ON Write all three files to `C:\Users\user\Desktop` with the filenames listed above. All three must share identical vertex and face counts. The three exported OBJs must satisfy: - Each contains exactly one SubTool named OrbBase, and all three share the same vertex and face counts. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_off.obj` matches the input `scene.obj` vertex-for-vertex within 1e-5 BU. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj`'s displacement from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_off.obj` concentrates in the belt: >=95 % of total displacement energy is on vertices with |z| < 0.15; total in-band energy > 0.01 BU. - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_on.obj`'s displacement from `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj` covers the OFF-band region: at least 50 % of vertices with |z| >= 0.15 show displacement > 0.005 BU. - Mean per-vertex Laplacian of `C:\Users\user\Desktop\all_on.obj` is at least 1.5x that of `C:\Users\user\Desktop\A_only.obj`. - Each of the three meshes is manifold.
